summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Talay 2/12)

data.turoyo: ṭabʕan ġalabe b maḥisuṯo simiwa w ḥiṣiwa, xayifo i nuro l azza aʕle, mkawzar əšmo, ap palkatayḏe me larwal.
data.translation: Nun, die Evangeliare aren in hoher Qualität hergestellt und festgebunden, so konnte das Feuer es nicht schnell verbrennen. Seine Blätter wurden ein wenig von außen versengt.

rationale: New Detransitive Preterit box; finite attained scorching contrasted with following attributive mkawzro.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (Talay 2/16)

data.turoyo: Həngi b ṭimo yo u ngalyunawo, d kəmmat, u mkawzro", — omar, — "b šrolo ba palkat komizaban b ʕAmariqa.
data.translation: weil jenes versengte Evangeliar, von dem du sprichst, weil es so wertvoll ist, - so sagte er, wahrlich, - wird es in Amerika blattweise verkauft.

rationale: New Detransitive Part. Pass. box; explicit attributive/substantivised scorched manuscript.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) versengt werden, anbrennen; in heiße Asche gelegt werden (Ei)

data.gloss: (Detrans.) versengt werden, anbrennen; in heiße Asche gelegt werden (Ei)

rationale: Supplies an explicit gloss for the inherited unnumbered Detransitive section; retains the old egg example and the scorching counterpart of active 1. No existing number changes.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo The bastiq/4)

data.turoyo: w kowinale moro d lo… d lә mikawzar, d qatre lowe ebe d nofәq šafiro, hawxa mayono xd u… xd u qaṭiro.
data.translation: We take care so that it does not burn, so that it does not go lumpy and it becomes nice, liquid just like, like yoghurt.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum cell; clear preventive scorching context and mi-kawzar variant.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Lahdo The ḥalile/4)

data.turoyo: w kit hәnn ste hawxa kosaymina qayso xud i gorәfto qana d… žboyәd d lә mәzlaq, mikawzar arʕә d i qošxane.
data.translation: and there is a piece of wood that we form like a scoop so that it won’t stick, burn at the bottom of the pot.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum cell; explicit bottom-of-pot location; scope uncertainty recorded.

data.turoyo: Ənkan d mazərqono harke, u Ṭuro d Šigur gṭəryono b ḥḏo, d mikawzər w d rabəʕ lo yoʕe ebe w lo morəq,
data.translation: Wenn ich hier mein Wasser lasse, so mache ich, daß der Berg Sindschar versengt wird und kein Frühlingskraut mehr dort wächst und grünt.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Infectum cell; complete condition and landscape extension.

summary: Retain stem I as in the glossary, despite the four radical letters and Q-shaped formation. The etymological Kurdish attribution and inherited active gloss remain unchanged.

The Detransitive has no overt acting participant in the target clause: food scorches in a preventive purpose clause; a mountain is made to become scorched; the Gospel is slightly scorched and subsequently called the scorched one.
Talay 2/12 finite mkawzar introduces an attained state under Detransitive Preterit; Talay 2/16 u mkawzro is attributive under Part. Pass. Both boxes are absent from this root’s inherited entry.
Infectum mi-kawzar/mi-kawzər in the new texts differs from inherited egg mikurzo. Preserve both without silently normalising the paradigm. 94/234 is already the exact active example.
Confirm whether negation shared with mәzlaq also scopes over mikawzar at Lahdo The ḥalile/4.
At Talay 2/12 does singular mkawzar predicate of the book, with pages as an afterthought, or is it invariant over plural pages?
How is the inherited egg mikurzo related to mi-kawzar? Verify the edition and dialect before regularising either form.
Restore geschlachteten in the animal-hair gloss
rationale: The gloss concerns singeing hair off a slaughtered animal. Geschalteten is an evident corruption of geschlachteten, consistent with the example about singeing heads and feet.

summary: Scorching extends from cookery to a landscape and a manuscript. Keep ordinary physical heat damage, without a new destructive or book-restoration sense.
